item.title: Anthropic 將會在 Claude 的文字內加上浮水印
item.summary: 看到蠻特別的東西 Anthropic 說他們會在 Claude 模型輸出的模型上面加上浮水印：「How Claude marks AI-generated content (via)」。 新的模型將會有浮水印，舊的也說會加上去： New models will mark AI-generated content from day one. Claude models launched in the EU on or after August 2, 2026 will support machine-readable marking at launch. Generated text will carry embedded watermarks, and generated files will include digitally signed provenance metadata where supported. … Continue reading "Anthropic 將會在 Claude 的文字內加上浮水印"
